not  immediately  required  for  the  purpose  of  the
Body  Corporate  in  such  manner  as  the  Body
Corporate may deem fit;
to acquire by purchase, gift, bequest, exchange or
in  any  other  manner  and  hold  any  movable  or
immovable  property and to take or give on lease or
mortgage, sell, grant, exchange or otherwise dispose
or deal with any such property acquired or held by
the Body Corporate as it may deem expedient with
a  view  to  promoting  the  objects  of  the  Body
Corporate;
to make, accept, endorse, negotiate, buy, sell and
issue bills of exchange, cheques, promissory notes
and other negotiable instruments;
to  construct,  purchase,  maintain  and  repair
anything  required  for  the  purpose  of  the  Body
Corporate;
to  appoint,  employ  and  dismiss  the  employees
required for  the carrying out of the objects of the
Body Corporate and pay them such remuneration
as may be determined by the  Body Corporate  and
make  ex gratia payments, gratuity to officers and
servants of the Body Corporate upon their retirement
and to the widows and orphans of such officers and
servants;
to  enter  into  and  perform  or  carry  out,  whether
directly or through any officer or agent authorised
in  that  behalf  by  the    Body  Corporate,  all  such
contracts or agreements as may be necessary for the
attainment  of  the  objects  or  the  exercise  of  the
powers of the Body Corporate;
